definitions.explanation: The sound or manner of many people talking, laughing, and having fun together in a lively, noisy way. Generally positive, describing cheerful group excitement.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ワイワイ⟦{騒|さわ}ぐ→騒ぐ：01195_sawagu⟧。
examples.english: Have a noisy, merry time together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ワイワイ⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like eating while chatting noisily with friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ワイワイ⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がって→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧、⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{一夜|いちや}→一夜：08961_ichiya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: At the year-end party, I had a fun evening getting lively and boisterous with my colleagues.

notes:
ワイワイ is an onomatopoeia representing the cheerful noise of a group of people. It has a positive, fun connotation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ワイワイ⟦{騒|さわ}ぐ→騒ぐ：01195_sawagu⟧ (make merry noise)
- ワイワイ⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (have a boisterous good time)
- ワイワイ⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧ (get lively and excited)
- ワイワイ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (chatter noisily)
- ワイワイガヤガヤ (noisy chatter from all directions)

USAGE:
- Almost always describes a positive, enjoyable atmosphere
- Often paired with ガヤガヤ to intensify the sense of lively noise: ワイワイガヤガヤ
- Can be used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: ワイワイ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have a lively, noisy time)
- Contrasts with ⟦うるさい→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧, which is purely negative noise
